title: 美联储官员关注债券收益率急升
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: This is the biggest gap between the actual two-year yield and the implied two-year yield from the SEP. We've seen increases over time, so yes, we have seen more increases recently, and I think
segments.zh: 这是实际两年期收益率与SEP隐含两年期收益率之间的最大差距。我们已看到随时间推移的上升，所以是的，近期上升更多，我认为

segments.en: it's really a combination of factors, and so I don't attribute them to anyone. Years across the term structure have increased further. Assigned and investors are reassessing the evolving
segments.zh: 这确实是多种因素的综合，所以我不将其归因于任何人。各期限收益率进一步上升。市场参与者正在重新评估不断变化的

segments.en: macroeconomic landscape. I think we could run a more effective bank and move more credit if you had a more traditional slow deal curve, so it's all relative right now. Markets are pretty good
segments.zh: 宏观经济格局。我认为，如果收益率曲线更传统地平缓，我们可以运营更有效的银行并转移更多信贷，所以目前一切都是相对的。市场相当不错

segments.en: when they want to send a signal, they will send a signal regardless of what the Fed is telling them.
segments.zh: 当市场想要发出信号时，无论美联储告诉他们什么，他们都会发出信号。
